title: TaskDeps
description: Cross-Story Task dependencies for a multi-repository span: the task-dependency-mapper writes <work>/candidates/task-deps.json and Python accepts it as <work>/task-deps.json. A single-repository span gets the empty document written by Python. At runtime the from and to strings are narrowed to an enum of the span's Task keys.

edges.description: The cross-Story edges; may be empty.

from.description: The prerequisite Task key, S<i>-<local key>.

to.description: The dependent Task key, S<i>-<local key>.

kind.title: TaskDepsEdgeKind
kind.description: What the dependent Task needs from the prerequisite.

acyclic.description: Whether the combined graph (same-Story edges, closure edges and these edges) is acyclic.

cycle.description: The Task keys naming the cycle; empty when acyclic is true.
